regimeSub: Russia sanction waiver lifts oil risk as Warsh stays mum, SPX recovers +0.4% despite 10Y breaching 5%.
themes: Trump Russia sanction waiver per WSJ/Reuters Oct 19 pulls Brent to $110 → oil retreats from $112 highs as supply disruption fears ease; SPX +0.4% to 7690 on risk relief despite bipartisan backlash per CBS

10Y Treasury breaches 5.09% per Yahoo Finance Oct 19 as bond selloff narrative shifts per Morningstar → 2Y -3bp to 4.74% suggests curve steepening on term premium; gold -0.8% to $4162 as real rates firm

Samsung/SK Hynix 'peak-out' fallout per BigGo Finance Oct 15 weighs on KOSPI at 5618 → BOK Nov hike remains live as President's Oct 13 'unavoidable' comment adds political pressure; USDKRW -0.3% to 1328

Warsh Oct 15-16 'price stability key' per PBS/CNBC but no rate signal → Sep CPI 4.0% YoY vs 3.7% prior keeps inflation overhang; core PCE at 3.0% leaves Fed optionality intact as retail sales +0.8% beats

headline: Trump's Russia sanction waiver eases oil supply fears and lifts risk sentiment despite 10Y breaching 5% and persistent 4% CPI overhang as Warsh maintains deliberate silence on rates.
